object.formatRecommendation: Service/Landing Page. The content should be structured to guide users directly to using the AI resume builder, featuring clear calls-to-action, benefit-driven copy, and social proof.
object.toneGuidelines: The tone should be encouraging, professional, and authoritative, instilling confidence in the user that the tool can effectively help them land a job. It should also be empathetic to the job seeker's challenges.
object.structureGuidelines: The page should feature a prominent value proposition above the fold, followed by clear sections detailing features and benefits, a 'how it works' guide, social proof (testimonials, success metrics), and a comprehensive FAQ. Calls-to-action should be strategically placed throughout the content.

recommendedOutlineSections.heading: Create Your Perfect Resume with AI in Minutes
recommendedOutlineSections.purpose: Immediately capture user attention with the core benefit and a strong call to action, addressing the transactional intent directly.

recommendedOutlineSections.heading: Why Our AI Resume Builder Stands Out
recommendedOutlineSections.purpose: Highlight unique features, benefits, and competitive advantages to convince users to choose this specific service over others, catering to the commercial aspect of the intent.

recommendedOutlineSections.heading: How It Works: Build Your Resume in 3 Simple Steps
recommendedOutlineSections.purpose: Provide a clear, concise guide on how to use the tool, reducing friction and encouraging immediate engagement and conversion.

recommendedOutlineSections.heading: Trusted by Millions: Success Stories & Testimonials
recommendedOutlineSections.purpose: Build trust and credibility through social proof, showcasing real-world success and reinforcing the value proposition to drive transactional completion.

recommendedOutlineSections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Our AI Resume Builder
recommendedOutlineSections.purpose: Address common concerns and objections, providing reassurance and removing any barriers to the user proceeding with the service.
